title: GIF workspace: every operation respects the trim bar; Speed and Loop fold into GIF output, Timing group leaves the rail
description: Setting the trim range then opening GIF output built the whole GIF (Fabio, 2026-09-20). No GIF op reads the control bar's range, while every video op does. One ranged-frames source for output, crop, resize, cut-out, reverse and GIF to Video; Trim, Speed and Loop count leave the rail and frame rate + loop count join the GIF output panel, mirroring the video GIF Maker.
